title: Enhance metadata specifications and component system
body:
## 完善基础元数据规范和控件体系 (Enhance Metadata Specifications and Component System)

Based on the goal of developing complete projects using JSON, this PR improves the fundamental metadata specifications and component system.

### Phase 1: Enhance Type Definitions ✅
- [x] Analyze current type system structure
- [x] Identify gaps in metadata specifications
- [x] Add missing common properties to BaseSchema (visible, hidden, disabled, name, label, description, placeholder, style, testId, ariaLabel)
- [x] Add comprehensive JSDoc documentation
- [x] Create CRUD operation schemas
- [x] Create API integration schemas

### Phase 2: Component System Features ✅
- [x] Add CRUD component schema with full Create/Read/Update/Delete support
- [x] Add ActionSchema for button actions with API integration
- [x] Add DetailSchema for record detail views
- [x] Add filter, pagination, and toolbar configurations
- [x] Add EventHandler system for dynamic interactions
- [x] Add DataFetchConfig for automatic data loading
- [x] Add Expression system for dynamic values

### Phase 3: Improve Protocol Specifications ✅
- [x] Create comprehensive JSON schema examples (user-management, api-integration)
- [x] Document component usage patterns (CRUD protocol, API integration)
- [x] Add validation schemas for runtime checking
- [x] Create CRUD protocol specification
- [x] Create API integration guide

### Phase 4: Developer Experience ✅
- [x] Add schema validation utilities (validateSchema, assertValidSchema, isValidSchema)
- [x] Create schema builder helpers (Form, CRUD, Button, Input, Card, Grid, Flex builders)
- [x] Improve TypeScript type inference with composite projects
- [x] Add schema composition utilities via fluent builders

### Phase 5: Documentation & Examples ✅
- [x] Update protocol documentation (CRUD, API integration)
- [x] Create comprehensive component catalog examples
- [x] Add real-world application examples (user management, API integration)
- [x] Create best practices guide

## Key Features Added

### 1. Enhanced Type Definitions
- Extended BaseSchema with conditional rendering properties (`visibleOn`, `hiddenOn`, `disabledOn`)
- Added semantic properties (name, label, description, placeholder)
- Added accessibility properties (ariaLabel, testId)
- New CRUD operation schemas for complete data management
- New API integration schemas for dynamic data and events

### 2. Schema Validation
```typescript
import { validateSchema, assertValidSchema } from '@object-ui/core';

const result = validateSchema(mySchema);
if (!result.valid) {
  console.error(result.errors);
}
```

### 3. Schema Builders
```typescript
import { crud, form, button } from '@object-ui/core/builder';

const userCRUD = crud()
  .resource('user')
  .api('/api/users')
  .columns([...])
  .enableCreate()
  .enableUpdate()
  .enableDelete()
  .pagination(20)
  .build();
```

### 4. Comprehensive Examples
- **user-management**: Complete CRUD interface with filters, pagination, batch actions
- **api-integration**: API calls, event handling, data fetching, conditional rendering

### 5. Documentation
- **CRUD Protocol**: Complete specification for CRUD components
- **API Integration Guide**: How to fetch data, submit forms, handle events
- **Best Practices**: Comprehensive guide for building maintainable apps

## Summary

✅ **All 5 phases complete!**

This PR delivers a comprehensive enhancement to Object UI's metadata specifications and component system, enabling developers to build complete, production-ready applications using pure JSON schemas with full type safety and excellent developer experience.

See [ENHANCEMENT_SUMMARY.md](./ENHANCEMENT_SUMMARY.md) for detailed documentation of all changes.

## Migration Guide

**No breaking changes.** All changes are additive and backward compatible. Existing schemas continue to work as before. New features are opt-in.

## Build Status

✅ All packages build successfully with `pnpm build`
✅ All packages lint successfully with `pnpm lint` (0 errors)
✅ TypeScript composite projects configured correctly
✅ Vercel build passing
